paths.title: AI for Real Estate
paths.tagline: Write listings, follow up with clients, research your market, and build a landing page — without ever inventing a fact.
paths.description: A 12-lesson path for real estate agents covering the AI workflows that save the most time in the field: writing and improving listing descriptions from rough notes, buyer and seller communication, safely summarizing disclosures and inspection reports, neighborhood and social copy, objection-handling practice, cited local market research with Perplexity, weekly lead and activity reporting, and building a simple listing landing page with Codex. Every lesson is built around one core habit — keep the AI grounded in facts you supply, and have it flag gaps instead of guessing.
